headline: 9 Michigan deals, $29M raised — led by RPM Ventures Space, L.P.

top_deals.summary: RPM Ventures Space, L.P., an Ann Arbor-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $165M raise; $0 sold.
RPM Ventures Space A, L.P., an Ann Arbor-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $35M raise; $0 sold.
Hachem Properties LLC, an Inkster-based commercial real estate company, filed a $25M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $25M sold to 1 investor.
TPCN Holdings, LLC, a Bloomfield Hills-based fund, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $6.1M of equity and pooled fund interests issued to 8 investors.
Akadeum Life Sciences, Inc., an Ann Arbor-based biotechnology company, filed a $3.4M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $2.1M sold to 9 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $29M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, up 166% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Hachem Properties LLC (Inkster, Commercial) targeting $25M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
TPCN Holdings, LLC disclosed a deal. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan private funds assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

4 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $6.1M raised so far — led by RPM Ventures Space, L.P. (Venture Capital Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
